rows.description: Faster transition to aim down sights (ADS) and no sprint speed penalty when carrying LMGs.
rows.limit: No sprint-speed penalty is stated by UI; L100-L104 did not source its operand. It is not a conflict or a sourced numeric exemption.

rows.description: Faster draw times and fire sooner when exiting a sprint with Assault Rifles.
rows.agreement: Draw and sprint-recovery +1 steps agree with faster draw and earlier fire after sprint.
rows.limit: No percentage or absolute time is stated in the UI.
rows.existingConditionalValues: All 11 ARs base index 5 -> 6: deploy 633.334 -> 533.334 ms, undeploy 233.334 -> 200.001 ms, sprint recovery 200.001 -> 166.667 ms.

rows.description: Reduced weapon sway, faster rechambering, and improved breath control with Sniper Rifles.
rows.agreement: Reduced sway agrees with the sourced x0.4444443882 trait and x2.25 penalty; rechamber text agrees with the separate timing candidate.
rows.limit: Improved breath control has no sourced operand in L100-L104. Faster rechambering is a candidate timing calculation, with activation/composition unresolved.
rows.existingConditionalValues: Six snipers, default optic (site sway factor 1.0): with the trait P10 alone 0.4444; P10 x M10 = 0.99999987; M10 alone (non-Recon, if the penalty is unconditional) 2.25. Camera sway has no site field.

rows.description: Improved hip-fire control when using SMGs.
rows.agreement: Hip row +1, standing 1.804 to 1.352 degrees and moving 2.255 to 1.690 degrees, agrees with improved hip-fire control.
rows.limit: The text does not identify individual hip fields.
rows.existingConditionalValues: All 10 SMGs hip row 4 -> 5: standing 1.804 -> 1.352 deg, moving 2.255 -> 1.690 deg; increase/decay unchanged.
